sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and wartime/armed forces syndication, Howard Culver as *Straight Arrow* saving an elderly stagecoach driver for Nabisco (1949), folk legend Cisco Houston singing for the Merchant Marine on *Treasury Salute* (1945), Rear Admiral Ellis M. Zacharias on *Secret Missions* (1948), jazz pianist Marty Napoleon on *The Navy Swings*, *Casey, Crime Photographer*, and *Stand By For Adventure* (1945–1964):
